# Key risk indicator (`key-risk-indicator` v1)

A metric watched against amber and red thresholds, with its recent history.

**Group:** Operational and non-financial risk · **Mnemonic:** `KRI` · **Identifiers:** `KRI-…` in `kriId`

Open one with `KRI <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: key-risk-indicator
version: 1
description: "A metric watched against amber and red thresholds, with its recent history."
match: { kind: key-risk-indicator, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Operational and non-financial risk · Key risk indicator, id: $.kriId }
strip:
  - { label: Indicator, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Desk, bind: $.deskName }
  - { label: Value, bind: $.value, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Amber, bind: $.amber, fmt: price2 }
  - { label: Red, bind: $.red, fmt: price2 }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
panels:
  - id: history
    kind: line
    title: Last 20 business days
    key: F2
    rows: $.history
    x: date
    y: value
    fmt: price2
  - id: definition
    kind: kv
    title: Definition
    area: right
    rows: $.definition
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.desk, 'desk')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
